replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged native channel starting handshake change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in native channel starting handshake; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Fresh push-mode pi-family channels publish incarnation-specific starting before native hello, using the existing harness handshake. Ownership waits until that incarnation is running; stopped incarnations remain fenced. Existing channel re-execution retains its saved state.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by native channel starting handshake; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by native channel starting handshake.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
